review.scope: Finite advisory fixtures for candidate generation and retrieval integrity. Expected results are deterministic and must be frozen before training or held-out evaluation.
review.implementation_observed: scripts/verify_retrieval.py covers the formal abstract score model, but no retrieval runtime implementation was found during this review; backend currently exposes EmbeddingEncoder.java only.

score_contract.formula: score = w_d * clamp((1 + cosine(q3072,r3072))/2,0,1) + w_p * shared_positive + w_c * shared_negative
score_contract.pool_overlap: size(intersection(unique(q),unique(r))) / max(size(unique(q)),size(unique(r))); zero for either empty; zero if environment/bounds/schema incompatible
score_contract.ranking: descending score then ascending immutable content ID
formula_critique: Full-vector cosine is the specified canonical score, not predicate-block cosine. Check all four block cosines as diagnostics; isolated block cosine is not algebraically interchangeable with full cosine because concatenation, normalization, and cross-block energy affect it.

The division by two is consistent with concatenating four individually unit-normalized blocks: the resulting vector norm is two. Verify the runtime actually renormalizes each adapted block before concatenation.

The positive and negative overlap terms are witness-membership evidence, not semantic labels. Exact context/bounds/schema compatibility and byte equality after digest lookup are prerequisites; incompatible contexts get zero overlap and an explicit label.
Weights must be finite, nonnegative and sum to one within tolerance. Candidate score must be higher-is-better; a distance must be transformed to similarity, never added as a descending-rank bonus.

Deduplicate witness identities before intersection and cardinality. For unequal pool sizes, max-size denominator bounds overlap by one and avoids rewarding larger N. Define empty-pool behavior explicitly as zero.

expected.failure_if: descending rank puts opposite first or treats larger cosine distance as better

expected.reason: unique sets are {a,b}, {a}, and {a,b,c,d}; denominator is max(unique cardinalities)

expected.failure_if: digest equality alone yields overlap or identity
positive witness matches negative pool or vice versa
pool overlap credited across distinct context identity
coerce, pad, truncate, or silently accept wrong block/model identity

violations: r1/r2 share family component across splits
r1/r3 share identical source hash across splits
expected.failure_if: training or synthetic variant lineage crosses a connected family component
identity pair counts toward nontrivial augmentation requirement
active query record remains eligible through adapter trained on revoked lineage
negative/nonfinite weights, non-unit sum, or score outside [0,1]

execution_notes: Execute each fixture against pure overlap/score functions before training and before inspecting held-out retrieval results.
Record exact runtime/model/content identities alongside results; failures must not be repaired by changing fixtures after outputs are seen.
The family leakage and revoked-lineage cases are policy/integrity checks, not relevance labels.
All judgments remain advisory. Solver-derived witness truth and exact compatibility metadata remain the ground truth for these tests.
